label: Creative & e-commerce VA
status: For small brands, creators, and remote teams

roleSpotlight.title: Keep daily work moving
roleSpotlight.summary: I organize recurring tasks, keep priorities visible, and flag issues early for small brands, creators, and remote teams.

items.title: Keep product and order information accurate
items.problem: Problem: listing errors and delayed order updates
deliverables: Standardize titles, variants, prices, and images
Keep order, inventory, and fulfillment trackers current
Flag missing details, delays, and refund requests early
items.outcome: Result: fewer catalog errors and faster customer updates

items.title: Keep requests, meetings, and follow-ups under control
items.problem: Problem: important messages and deadlines get buried
deliverables: Organize messages using labels and priority rules
Draft replies and confirm meeting details
Maintain follow-up tracking and daily priorities
items.outcome: Result: fewer missed requests, meetings, and deadlines

items.title: Keep approved content moving on schedule
items.problem: Problem: assets sit in folders and posting becomes inconsistent
deliverables: Adapt captions and assets for each platform
Schedule approved posts and organize files
Update the publishing tracker and weekly metrics
items.outcome: Result: consistent publishing with clear progress visibility
